exposure: receiving maternal care in personal offices
high age of marriage and pregnancy
cohort: 460 primiparous women in Iran (230 who had a cesarean section and 230 who had a vaginal delivery)
finding: Factors associated with choosing a cesarean section included higher maternal education, higher socioeconomic level, husband's preference for cesarean, living with the husband's family, physician's recommendation, receiving maternal care in private offices, fear of delivery pain, low maternal knowledge, older age at marriage and pregnancy, history of abortion, and lack of family support.
mod_finding: Half of the cesarean sections were performed due to the physician's insistence, and satisfaction with cesarean section was 70% compared to 77% satisfaction with vaginal delivery.
